note: Daily scan 12 Nov: VLCC hit on the Ruwais-Dubai route with crew injured, and Allianz Trade's estimate of Gulf war damage.

signals.summary: The Liberia-flagged VLCC MT Fujairah Energy was hit by a projectile in the Gulf on 10 Nov while sailing from Ruwais to Dubai. Four of its 22 crew were injured, one taken ashore with minor injuries; the others are safe. Damage was not reported and no attacker was named. Gulf News reports it as separate from the attack on an ADNOC L&S vessel the same day.
signals.check: Confirm whether this is the same incident as SQ-0080 (ADNOC L&S vessel). Either way, strikes on the Ruwais-Dubai coastal route bring attacks closer to UAE coastal assets: review alert levels for coastal substations and desalination intakes.
signals.notes: Opened Marine Insight (11 Nov) and Gulf News (11 Nov, grade C). No UKMTO or official UAE statement found. Relevant to ER-02 and ER-01; link once confirmed by an official source.

signals.summary: Credit insurer Allianz Trade estimates the war has caused just over USD 200 bn of physical damage across the Gulf, mainly to energy infrastructure: more than 80 energy facilities hit, mostly in Kuwait, Qatar and Bahrain, about a third severely. It puts cumulative GCC output losses at about USD 790 bn by 2030 (5.9% of GDP) and infrastructure and defence spending at USD 380-400 bn by 2030. No UAE-specific figures.
signals.check: Get the Allianz Trade report itself and check its UAE figures, and ask finance whether insurers are repricing property cover for utility assets in the Gulf.
signals.notes: Opened Brussels Times (11 Nov); the same figures appear in Gulf News, The New Arab and Oman Observer. Allianz Trade report not opened. Context for ER-02 (attacks on Gulf energy sites).
